titleEn: Sommet de l’Élevage 2026: 4 days at heart of Europe’s livestock industry
titleZh: 2026年法国畜牧业展：四天聚焦欧洲畜牧业主流趋势
summaryZh: 2026年10月6日至9日，第35届法国畜牧业展（Sommet de l'Élevage）将在克莱蒙费朗举办，预计吸引1800家展商和12万名专业观众。展会恰逢国际牧场与牧民年，将设立动物健康中心、新增1万平方米农机展区，并展示70多个品种的遗传资源。利木赞牛将成为2026年焦点品种。展会还将举办140多场会议，并为国际观众安排30场牧场参观。
featuredReason: 该展会集中展示畜牧业在遗传育种、动物健康、精准农业和数字技术方面的最新进展，是了解欧洲畜牧业技术趋势和可持续转型方向的重要窗口，适合智慧畜牧从业者关注行业前沿动态。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Sponsored Sommet de l'Élevage 2026: 4 days at heart of Europe's livestock industry ![Image 1: Agriland Team By Agriland Team August 21, 2026 5:00 AM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthoragriland-team) Share this article ![Image 2](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newssommet-de-lelevage-2026-4-days-at-heart-of-europes-livestock-industry) Sponsored by !Image 3 As livestock farming continues to evolve in response to economic pressures, animal health challenges and the transition towards more sustainable production systems, the Sommet de l'Élevage remains one of Europe's key meeting points for farmers and livestock professionals. From October 6 to 9, 2026, the exhibition will return to Clermont-Ferrand, France, for its 35th edition, bringing together 1,800 exhibitors and around 120,000 professional visitors, including 6,000 international visitors from across the globe. Whether you are looking for the latest livestock technologies, new breeding genetics, machinery, animal health solutions or practical ideas to improve farm performance, the Sommet offers four days dedicated entirely to the future of livestock farming. The 2026 edition takes place during the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists, highlighting the importance of grazing systems and their contribution to sustainable agriculture. Reflecting these challenges, the exhibition will present innovations covering every aspect of animal production, from genetics and nutrition to precision farming, digital technologies and farm equipment. Details on tickets and booking entry badges available here Sommet de l'Élevage Several new features will enrich this year's programme. A dedicated Animal Health Hub will bring together companies specialising in veterinary products, disease prevention, biosecurity and animal welfare, while the agricultural machinery sector continues to grow with an additional 10,000m² of exhibition space, allowing visitors to discover even more equipment and live demonstrations. ![Image 4](https:images.agriland.ieqmCcZGB5RKbM1HJJ9n1WrOagQsyAI-px4A1oJ57wQrs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202608charolais.jpeg) Animal genetics remain one of the exhibition's defining strengths. More than 70 breeds of cattle, sheep, goats and horses will be showcased throughout the event, with the Limousin breed taking centre stage in 2026 through national competitions and technical presentations. For breeders looking to improve herd performance, the exhibition provides an unrivalled opportunity to compare genetics and meet leading breeding organisations. For more information, click here Knowledge sharing is another cornerstone of the event. More than 140 conferences, technical seminars and round-table discussions will explore the issues currently shaping livestock farming, including sustainability, climate resilience, innovation, animal welfare, market developments and the future of European agriculture. Visitors will have the opportunity to exchange ideas with researchers, industry experts and fellow farmers while discovering practical solutions that can be applied on farm. Farm visits For international visitors, one of the highlights remains the exclusive programme of 30 organised farm visits across the Massif Central. Reserved solely for overseas participants, these guided tours provide a unique opportunity to visit commercial livestock farms, meet French breeders and experience production systems in real working conditions - an initiative that has become one of the event's defining features. ![Image 5](https:images.agriland.ieLssWTQlQGpS2nKPfuro6A6kG7FkO5zuUjDOjHCSnmYrs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202608stands-interieurs.jpg) Combining business opportunities, technical expertise and on-farm experience, the Sommet De L'Élevage 2026 offers much more than a traditional trade fair. It is a place where professionals can exchange ideas, discover new technologies and build valuable international partnerships. For anyone involved in the livestock sector, it is an opportunity to gain fresh inspiration, identify practical solutions and help shape the future of sustainable farming. translationZh:
随着畜牧业持续应对经济压力、动物健康挑战以及向更可持续生产体系转型的进程，法国畜牧业展（Sommet de l'Élevage）依然是欧洲农民和畜牧业专业人士的重要汇聚点之一。

2026年10月6日至9日，该展会将在法国克莱蒙费朗迎来第35届，届时将汇集1800家参展商和约12万名专业观众，其中包括来自全球各地的6000名国际观众。

无论您是在寻找最新的畜牧技术、新的育种遗传资源、机械设备、动物健康解决方案，还是提升农场绩效的实用思路，法国畜牧业展都将提供整整四天的时间，完全专注于畜牧业的未来。

2026年展会恰逢国际牧场与牧民年，彰显了放牧系统的重要性及其对可持续农业的贡献。为回应这些挑战，展会将展示涵盖动物生产各个方面的创新成果，从遗传育种和营养到精准农业、数字技术和畜牧设备。

**多项新亮点**

今年的展会将增添多项新内容。专门的动物健康中心将汇集从事兽药产品、疾病预防、生物安全和动物福利的企业，而农业机械展区则继续扩大，新增了10000平方米的展览空间，让观众能够发现更多设备并观看现场演示。

动物遗传资源仍是展会的核心优势之一。整个活动期间将展出牛、羊、山羊和马等70多个品种，其中利木赞牛将在2026年通过全国竞赛和技术演示成为焦点品种。对于希望提高畜群性能的养殖者来说，该展会提供了比较遗传资源和接触领先育种组织的绝佳机会。

**知识共享**

知识共享是展会的另一大基石。超过140场会议、技术研讨会和圆桌讨论将探讨当前影响畜牧业的问题，包括可持续性、气候韧性、创新、动物福利、市场发展和欧洲农业的未来。观众将有机会与研究人员、行业专家和同行农民交流思想，同时发现可在农场实际应用的解决方案。

**牧场参观**

对于国际观众来说，最精彩的环节之一仍然是专为海外参与者保留的30场中央高原（Massif Central）牧场参观计划。这些导览活动提供了参观商业化畜牧场、与法国养殖者会面并体验实际生产体系的独特机会——这一举措已成为该展会的标志性特色之一。

法国畜牧业展2026将商业机会、专业技术与实地体验相结合，提供的远不止传统贸易展会的内容。它是一个专业人士可以交流思想、发现新技术和建立宝贵国际伙伴关系的平台。对于任何参与畜牧业的人来说，这都是一个获得新灵感、找到实用解决方案并帮助塑造可持续农业未来的机会。
